text: Two secret words used one after the other on the table add up: each place uses one slot of each word, and each known letter forces their total.
Drawn for the PALIMPSEST alphabet on the message and the ABSCISSA alphabet on the copper; the experiment tried all 63 x 63 pairs built from the puzzle's words.
666,792 cases: 770 pairs of lengths survive, none with a total below 22, which is what chance leaves; no survivor is made of puzzle words.
